cases.text: The Assistant Bakery Operations Manager (ABOM) is a leadership pipeline role designed to develop the next generation of Bakery Operations Managers. ABOMs are expected to operate at near-BOM level, executing bakery operations with urgency, accuracy, and accountability while building the leadership skills needed to run a bakery independently. This role blends hands-on operational excellence with talent development, administrative ownership, and team leadership. ABOMs act as a true extension of the BOM and must be capable of stepping into full bakery ownership when needed. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Operational Execution •Execute all core bakery operations including inventory rotation, scheduling support, staffing coordination, and administrative checklists •Maintain strict adherence to product quality, cleanliness, food safety, and guest experience standards •Support ordering, inventory accuracy, and shrink control •Assist in schedule creation and labor execution to meet operational targets Talent & Team Development •Support recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and training of new staff •Deliver consistent coaching and real-time performance feedback •Hold team members accountable to standards while reinforcing a growth mindset culture •Ensure onboarding and training programs are executed to company standards Leadership & Ownership •Manage bakery operations independently in the absence of the BOM •Model urgency, accountability, and operational discipline •Partner with BOM and Area leadership to identify operational gaps and implement solutions •Maintain continuity of operations during leadership transitions or staffing shortages •Other duties as assigned WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE: •Able to independently execute all BOM-level administrative and operational tasks •Bakery is fully staffed, trained, and operating at high standards •Strong culture of accountability and consistency •Acts as a reliable operational leader during any coverage scenario •Demonstrates clear readiness and upward mobility toward a BOM role QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE: •1+ year leadership experience in restaurant, retail, or hospitality operations •Strong Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"!  At Insomnia Cookies, warm cookies are just the beginning. As a Cookie Crew Bike Delivery Driver , you'll be the face of Insomnia Cookies—bringing warm cookies, brownies, and other sweet treats directly to our guests by bicycle. Whether it's a late-night study break, birthday celebration, office snack, or just someone's cookie craving, you'll help create memorable moments with every delivery. When you're not making deliveries, you'll be part of the bakery team—helping prepare orders, assisting guests, and keeping the bakery running smoothly. Every shift is fast-paced, active, and never quite the same. If you enjoy staying active, know your city well, and love working with great people, this could be the perfect role for you. WHAT YOU’LL DO: Every shift is a mix of driving, hospitality, and teamwork. You'll: Deliver orders safely, accurately, and efficiently by bicycle. Ensure every order arrives warm, complete, and on time. Navigate city streets safely while following all traffic laws and company safety guidelines. Communicate with guests professionally during every delivery. Assist with preparing, packaging, and organizing delivery orders before heading out. Welcome guests and provide exceptional service inside the bakery between deliveries. Help bake, decorate, package, and stock products as needed. Keep the bakery clean, organized, and food-safe. Support your teammates during busy shifts to keep orders moving quickly and accurately. Help create the kind of guest experience that keeps people coming back.  QUALIFICATIONS Must be 18 years of age or older Ability to safety operate a bicycle in an urban environment Own a Smartphone capable of running company delivery applications. Availability to work evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays. Physical Requirements This position regularly requires the ability to: Ride a bicycle for extended periods throughout a shift. Frequently mount and dismount a bicycle. Carry and transport delivery bags weighing up to 30 pounds. Stand, walk, bend, reach, squat, and twist throughout the workday. Work in varying outdoor weather conditions. Enter and exit apartment buildings, offices, and residences, including climbing stairs when elevators are unavailable. Work safely around bakery equipment, ovens, refrigeration units, and cleaning products. Communicate effectively with guests and team members. Work Environment You'll divide your time between our bakery and city streets. Inside the bakery, you'll work in a fast-paced environment with ovens, refrigeration equipment, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Outside, you'll ride in changing weather conditions, varying traffic patterns, and urban environments while following all safety policies and local traffic laws. Schedule Expectations Our busiest times are evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Bike Delivery Drivers should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location. Equal Employment Opportunity Insomnia Cookies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. Reasonable Accommodation If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Additional Information Employment with Insomnia Cookies is contingent upon successful completion of any background checks, employment verification, and other pre-employment requirements applicable to the position and permitted by law. Ready to Join the Cookie Crew? Whether this is your first job or your next step, we're looking for people who bring great energy, take pride in their work, and love making someone's day a little sweeter. When you join Insomnia Cookies, you'll enjoy: Competitive hourly pay plus tips Early Wage Access (get paid the next day!) Flexible scheduling Employee discount (free cookies!) Opportunities for growth into Shift Leader and other bakery leadership roles Many of our leaders started as Cookie Crew Members and Delivery Drivers. If you're looking for more than just a job, you'll find plenty of opportunities to grow with us. We can’t wait to meet you!

Operate the register and process guest transactions. Keep the bakery clean, stocked, organized, and food-safe throughout every shift. Jump in wherever your team needs you, whether that's restocking supplies, helping a teammate, or keeping the line moving. Resolve guest concerns with empathy and urgency, partnering with your Shift Leader when needed. Deliver the kind of experience that turns first-time guests into lifelong Insomniacs. Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units. Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures. cases.text: Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery + delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. With an expanding footprint of over 350 stores globally, an experiential, “sweet-easy” flagship concept, and large scale operations and delivery capabilities ... Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"! Insomnia Cookies was founded in a college dorm room by then-student, Seth Berkowitz. Fast forward 20 years and so... many....cookies... later, our innovative bakery + delivery concept has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia’s warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night. With an expanding footprint of over 350 stores globally, an experiential, “sweet-easy” flagship concept, and large scale operations and delivery capabilities ... Insomnia Cookies is revolutionizing the cookie game by truly "Imagining What’s Possible"!  At Insomnia Cookies, our Shift Leaders are the leaders in action. As the person leading the shift, you'll work side-by-side with your Cookie Crew to deliver warm, delicious cookies and an exceptional guest experience. From baking and packing orders to coaching teammates and keeping the bakery running smoothly, you'll lead by example every shift. If you enjoy fast-paced environments, love working with people, and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves, this is the role for you. WHAT YOU'LL DO: As the leader on duty, you will: Lead bakery operations during your shift, ensuring an exceptional guest experience from start to finish. Bake, package, and prepare orders while providing exceptional guest service. Coach and motivate Cookie Crew members, providing direction, feedback, and support throughout the shift. Prioritize and delegate tasks to keep operations running efficiently and meet guest demand. Help maintain our standards for product quality, food safety, cleanliness, and speed of service. Handle cash management, register accountability, and deposits. Communicate important updates and partner with store leadership to keep the bakery operating at its best. Jump in wherever needed to help your team succeed.  QUALIFICATIONS 1+ year of experience in retail, restaurant, hospitality, or another customer-focused environment Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment Positive attitude with a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences Must be 18 years of age or older Ability to obtain any required food safety certifications applicable to the location Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation. Physical Requirements This position regularly requires the ability to: Stand and walk for extended periods of time (up to 8 hours per shift). Frequently reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, and lift. Lift, carry, push, and pull up to 30 pounds regularly. Occasionally lift up to 50 pounds with assistance. Use hands and fingers to handle bakery equipment, food products, and a point-of-sale system. Work in environments with varying temperatures, including around ovens, freezers, and refrigeration units. Safely operate kitchen equipment in accordance with company procedures. Read order screens, recipes, and safety information. Communicate effectively with guests and team members in a fast-paced environment. Work Environment This position works in a fast-paced bakery environment that includes frequent interaction with guests, exposure to heat from ovens, refrigerated storage areas, cleaning chemicals, and moderate noise levels. Evening, late-night, weekend, and holiday shifts are a regular part of the business. Schedule Expectations Our bakeries are busiest during evenings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. Team Members should have availability during these peak business hours. Scheduling needs vary by location. Equal Employment Opportunity Insomnia Cookies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. Reasonable Accommodation If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or hiring process, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Additional Information Employment with Insomnia Cookies is contingent upon successful completion of any background checks, employment verification, and other pre-employment requirements applicable to the position and permitted by law. Ready to Join? Whether this is your first job or your next step, we're looking for people who bring great energy, take pride in their work, and love making someone's day a little sweeter. When you join Insomnia Cookies, you'll enjoy: Competitive hourly pay Early Wage Access (get paid the next day!) Flexible scheduling Employee discount (free cookies!) This is more than a shift supervisor role—it's your opportunity to develop your leadership skills, make an impact every day, and grow your career with one of the fastest-growing bakery brands in the country. Many of our Assistant Managers and Store Managers began their journey as Shift Leaders. If you're ready to lead a great team, delight guests, and help create warm moments one cookie at a time, we'd love to have you join the Insomnia Cookies family.
